name: Veggie Pizza
description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Sloppy Joe Squares
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring a sloppy joe beef mixture between two layers of crescent roll dough, topped with mozzarella cheese and baked until golden brown.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the beef, onions, and spices in a skillet over medium heat until the meat is no longer red.
Blend in flour to thicken the mixture.
Add 1¼ cups water, ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 9×13 inch pan with 1 package of crescent rolls.
Spread the beef mixture evenly over the layer of rolls.
Top the beef mixture with mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the second package of crescent dinner rolls, ensuring the dough touches the edges of the pan.
Bake at 350°F until the crescent rolls are browned.
Serve with a salad.

_similar.keywords: sloppy joe, casserole, crescent rolls, beef

recipeInstructions.text: Put all ingredients in a blender or food processor and blend for 2 minutes.
Can be kept in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

_similar.name: Spinach Lettuce Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and versatile green salad with a homemade balsamic dressing and a crunchy topping made from toasted almonds, sesame seeds, and noodle soup mix.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg noodle soup mix (without seasoning packet)
Any type of green leafy vegetable (spinach, lettuce, broccoli, coleslaw)

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the dressing ingredients together and refrigerate until ready to use.
Melt butter in a pan and add almonds, noodle soup mix (without spice packet), and sesame seeds. Toast until lightly browned.
Prepare the salad greens and store in the refrigerator.
Just before serving, pour the dressing over the salad and top with the toasted almond mixture.

_similar.keywords: spinach salad, lettuce salad, homemade dressing, crunchy topping

_similar.name: Layered Coleslaw Salad
_similar.description: A layered coleslaw salad with shredded carrots, snow peas, and a creamy Miracle Whip dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (8.5 oz) Oriental flavor dry noodles

recipeInstructions.text: Shred cabbage and place in bottom of large glass bowl. Top with remaining ingredients in order given.
Combine Miracle Whip, sour cream, and package of noodle seasoning. Spread evenly over salad.
Cover and let stand overnight.

_similar.keywords: layered coleslaw, creamy dressing, overnight salad

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, crunchy taco chips, and cheddar cheese, all tossed in Catalina dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, cheddar cheese
